title: Nukes
desc: Cold-war territory control on a hex map. Hostages fuel your moves but reinforce your enemy. Build bases, convert isotopes, and threaten nuclear strikes.

title: Planet Mongo
desc: Hex-based territory control in the Flash Gordon universe. Eight factions fight for dominance across 127 hexagonal tiles with hidden orders, bluffing, and a dynamic central market.

title: Endless Skies
desc: 4X space exploration with worker placement and fleet management. Eight asymmetric factions compete across a hex-tile galaxy, placing crew in ship rooms and diplomats in space ports to complete contracts for victory points.
